title: test_a7 reads the regression's live record from inside each stage's command instead of sampling it every 0.2 s
objective: T108Acceptance.test_a7_live_record_shows_stage_quick passes on every run, because each stage's own test command reads the live record while that stage runs, instead of the test sampling the record every 0.2 s from outside.
outline: Only tests_devloop/test_regression_fixer.py, method T108Acceptance.test_a7_live_record_shows_stage_quick (lines 217-239 on main): replace the body. Today it declares quick as "sh -c 'sleep 4; TESTS quick'" and starts regression.py with Popen. It then re-reads the live record every 0.2 s for up to 20 s and checks that 'quick' and then 'full' were seen. New body: build `live` and `snap` as in the acceptance, write tests.quick and tests.full into board/config.json and commit, call self.regression(), then assert as in the acceptance. Add one comment line above the commands saying why: regression.py writes the stage into the live record before it starts that stage's command and waits for it (devloop/regression.py:136-145), so what the command copies is the record during that stage. The full stage lasts only about 0.1 s with the fake suite, which is too short to sample. json, os, TESTS and git are already imported in the file; subprocess and time stay in use elsewhere in the file. Words to avoid on every added line (board/config.json hard_block.patterns): "os.kill", "killpg", "pkill", "kill -".
test_plan: No verifier: the change touches no product code, so no new case can be red before it; the existing case itself is the one changed. The implementer: (1) rewrites the case per acceptance 1-4; (2) runs mutations M1 and M2 once each by hand (acceptance 5). Save a copy of devloop/regression.py first, restore from the copy and check `git diff --stat devloop/regression.py` is empty; neither mutation is committed. (3) Runs the ten-run loop (acceptance 6). (4) Runs the whole class `test_regression_fixer.T108Acceptance` once (about 30 s measured for a similar run) and the base set. Report the observed red messages of M1 and M2 and the green count of the ten-run loop in the hand-in. Nothing here runs the full suite.
notes: Cause (measured 2026-11-24 on main 2266d4e, in a throwaway LoopCase in a scratch clone): a race in the test, not in the product. regression.py writes the live record's stage before each stage and drops the record when it ends (put_live at devloop/regression.py:129/136/143, drop in main's finally at :202). The record held 'full' for only 0.102-0.136 s in six runs, because the fake full suite returns at once and that window is just testiface plus fake startup plus the worktree removal. The test samples every 0.2 s plus the read time, so it misses the window about half the time. The same probe saw preflight at about 0.06 s, quick from about 0.18 s, full from about 4.3 s and the process exit at about 4.4 s. Measured rate: the original case failed 5 of 10 runs, each with exactly "AssertionError: 'full' not found in ['quick'] : ['quick']", the message from the regression. Hypotheses: H1 (the full window is shorter than the poll interval) is confirmed by the timings above. H2 (the 20 s deadline ran out during quick) is ruled out: quick ended about 4.3 s after start, far from 20 s; the new case has no deadline anyway. H3 (the product never writes 'full') is ruled out: the probe saw 'full' in every run. Fix design: the stage's own command copies the live record at its start. regression.py is blocked on that command, and osx.write_json writes atomically, so the copy always holds a complete record of that stage. No sleep, retry or poll is involved. Measured on today's code with exactly the commands in acceptance 2: 10 of 10 green in 5.3 s total; M1 red with {'quick': 'quick', 'full': 'quick'}; M2 red with {'quick': 'preflight', 'full': 'full'}. A preflight snapshot is left out on purpose: verify() already writes stage 'preflight' before taking the slot when no slot is needed (regression.py:76), so removing the put_live at :129 would not turn it red. The stage order preflight, quick, full stays asserted by test_a3 through FAKE_INTERVALS. Group: new-g1, because g7 is verified and takes no new tickets and no other group is open. No dependency: #108's case is already on main. Base set: board/config.json lists test_testiface, but no test_testiface.py exists in tests/ or tests_devloop/ (checked 2026-11-24). Its one ImportError row is not this ticket's (inferred from #108's notes). Out of scope: the other live-record polls in the suite (test_regression_fixer.py around line 1343, test_controller.py around line 825); changing regression.py or the live record; any change to fake_tests.py.
acceptance: tests_devloop/test_regression_fixer.py T108Acceptance.test_a7_live_record_shows_stage_quick keeps its name and its place in the class (between test_a6_full_red_after_green_quick_is_reported_as_today and test_a8_controller_fix_round_and_decision_carry_the_quick_red).

The case sets two commands in self.proj/board/config.json and commits them (read the JSON, set cfg['tests']['quick'] and cfg['tests']['full'], write it, git add -A, git commit, the same steps declare_quick does). Each command is exactly "sh -c 'cp %s %s; %s %s'" % (live, snap[stage], TESTS, stage). Here live = os.path.join(self.tmp, 'wt', 'runs', 'live', 'regression-int-g1.json'), snap[stage] = os.path.join(self.tmp, 'live-at-%s.json' % stage), and stage is 'quick' or 'full'.

The case runs the regression synchronously with the existing helper `res, r = self.regression()`, which creates int/g1 from main and runs regression.py with --out. It asserts res.returncode == 0. For each stage it asserts that snap[stage] exists, with a message naming the stage. It then asserts that the dict {stage: json.load(snap[stage]).get('stage')} equals {'quick': 'quick', 'full': 'full'}.
The case has no polling loop, no time.sleep, no `sleep` inside a declared command, no subprocess.Popen, no proc.terminate and no wall-clock deadline (time.time() based).

Red before the fix, measured (implementer runs each once by hand and restores the file from a saved copy afterwards). M1: in devloop/regression.py `_verify`, replace `put_live(cfg, branch, sha, out_path, "full")` (line 143 on main) with `pass`. The case is then red with {'quick': 'quick', 'full': 'quick'}. M2: replace `put_live(cfg, branch, sha, out_path, "quick")` (line 136) with `pass`. The case is then red with {'quick': 'preflight', 'full': 'full'}.

Ten separate runs of the case on the unmutated tree are all green. Run by hand, once: `for i in $(seq 10); do python3 "$AC_HOME/devloop/run_tests.py" test_regression_fixer.T108Acceptance.test_a7_live_record_shows_stage_quick || break; done`, from the worktree. A run that prints 'machine busy' ran nothing; report how many runs actually ran.

Unchanged: devloop/regression.py, tests_devloop/fake_tests.py, tests_devloop/loop_harness.py, the helper methods of T108Acceptance (declare_quick, commit_file, stages, regression, ids, iface; declare_quick keeps its one `cmd` parameter), every other method of T108Acceptance (a1-a6, a8, a9), and CODE-MAP.md (a script regenerates it; the method name does not change).
token_basis: One test method (about 25 lines) rewritten in tests_devloop/test_regression_fixer.py. Reading: devloop/regression.py _verify (40 lines) and the T108Acceptance helpers (60 lines). Two hand-run mutations and a ten-run loop of one case, which takes about 0.5 s (measured: ten runs in 5.3 s). No verifier and no reviewer. Calibrated on landed simple tickets without a verifier (cost_total including cache reads and the opener's run, pool 2026-11-24): #102 2.72M, #105 2.85M, #110 1.70M, #126 2.89M. The implementer's share of those is lower, and this change is smaller than any of them.
vision: VISION metric 'first-time pass rate' (一次就過測試的比例) and 'tokens and time per landed ticket' (每張落地票的 token 與時間). Measured on today's main: this case fails 5 of 10 runs, so about half of all regressions see it fail. Each failure costs a second-look rerun (about 5 s), and when no open flaky ticket carries the id, one opener run (like this one). After the change the case is deterministic (10 of 10 green, measured) and the suite is about 4.5 s shorter per regression (inferred: the case takes about 0.5 s instead of about 5 s).
removes: Removes the timing-dependent check in test_a7: the 0.2 s sampling loop with its 20 s deadline, and the 4 s sleep in its declared quick command. Adds no gate, rule or step.
